data.one_liner: A storybook for Flutter widgets to showcase and preview isolated components.
data.what_it_does: Provides a live preview of isolated Flutter widgets to speed up development. Includes built-in plugins for contents, device frames, and knobs for interactive parameter tweaking.
use_when: You want to showcase and test widgets in isolation
You want to allow designers or developers to tweak widget parameters using interactive knobs
You need to run golden tests on your widget stories
avoid_when: You are building a production backend or state management solution
You do not need a component library viewer
strengths: Includes a rich plugin system (knobs, device frames, logging)
Supports golden testing via a companion package
weaknesses: Plugins documentation is largely TBD in the current version
